root.name: form1
root.code:
' ===== Muncher: a maze-chase game =====
' Eat every dot while three bugs hunt you. A big dot lets you eat the bugs for a few seconds.
' The maze is ONE string: 19 columns x 19 rows, one character per cell.
'   "#" wall   "." dot   "o" big dot   " " empty floor.   Row 9 is a tunnel: leave on one side, enter on the other.
' Bug data is packed into one string (no arrays): 5 fields per bug, 2 characters each, value + 20.
'   fields: 0 = column, 1 = row, 2 = direction x, 3 = direction y, 4 = scared (1/0)
' Controls on the form: Canvas1 (380 x 380), lblScore, lblLives, lblHelp, cmdNew, cmdUp, cmdLeft, cmdRight, cmdDown

Const COLS = 19
Const ROWS = 19
Const CELL = 20
Const OFS = 20

Dim maze As String
Dim gs As String
Dim px As Integer       ' player cell
Dim py As Integer
Dim pdx As Integer      ' direction the player is moving
Dim pdy As Integer
Dim ndx As Integer      ' direction the player wants to turn to (taken as soon as the way is free)
Dim ndy As Integer
Dim fx As Integer       ' direction the player is facing (for drawing)
Dim fy As Integer
Dim score As Integer
Dim hi As Integer
Dim lives As Integer
Dim level As Integer
Dim pellets As Integer
Dim fright As Integer   ' ticks of "bugs are scared" left
Dim tickN As Integer
Dim hold As Integer     ' ticks to wait (after a lost life / new level)
Dim playing As Boolean
Dim paused As Boolean
Dim over As Boolean

Sub Form_Load()
    hi = 0
    lives = 3
    level = 1
    InitMaze
    ResetPositions
    Draw
End Sub

' ---------- buttons ----------
Sub cmdNew_Click()
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    level = 1
    over = False
    paused = False
    InitMaze
    ResetPositions
    hold = 8
    playing = True
    StartTimer Speed()
    Draw
End Sub

Sub cmdUp_Click()
    ndx = 0
    ndy = -1
End Sub

Sub cmdDown_Click()
    ndx = 0
    ndy = 1
End Sub

Sub cmdLeft_Click()
    ndx = -1
    ndy = 0
End Sub

Sub cmdRight_Click()
    ndx = 1
    ndy = 0
End Sub

' ---------- keyboard: arrows steer, Space pauses, Enter starts ----------
Sub Form_KeyDown(KeyCode As Integer)
    Select Case KeyCode
        Case vbKeyLeft
            cmdLeft_Click
        Case vbKeyRight
            cmdRight_Click
        Case vbKeyUp
            cmdUp_Click
        Case vbKeyDown
            cmdDown_Click
        Case vbKeySpace
            If playing Then
                If paused Then
                    paused = False
                Else
                    paused = True
                End If
                Draw
            End If
        Case vbKeyReturn
            If Not playing Then cmdNew_Click
    End Select
End Sub

' ---------- the game loop ----------
Sub Form_Timer()
    If playing Then
        If Not paused Then Tick
    End If
End Sub

Sub Tick()
    Dim i
    Dim mv As Boolean
    If hold > 0 Then
        hold = hold - 1
        Draw
        Exit Sub
    End If
    tickN = tickN + 1
    MovePlayer
    CheckHits
    If hold > 0 Or Not playing Then
        Draw
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If pellets = 0 Then
        NextLevel
        Draw
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' the bugs leave one after the other; they are a little slower than you, and much slower while scared
    For i = 0 To 2
        mv = True
        If tickN < i * 12 Then mv = False
        If (tickN Mod 4) = 3 Then mv = False
        If fright > 0 Then
            If (tickN Mod 2) = 0 Then mv = False
        End If
        If mv Then MoveBug i
    Next i
    CheckHits
    If fright > 0 Then
        fright = fright - 1
        If fright = 0 Then SetScared 0
    End If
    Draw
End Sub

Sub MovePlayer()
    Dim c
    ' turn if the wanted direction is free
    If ndx <> 0 Or ndy <> 0 Then
        If Not IsWall(px + ndx, py + ndy) Then
            pdx = ndx
            pdy = ndy
        End If
    End If
    ' keep going while the way ahead is free
    If pdx <> 0 Or pdy <> 0 Then
        If Not IsWall(px + pdx, py + pdy) Then
            px = WrapX(px + pdx)
            py = py + pdy
            fx = pdx
            fy = pdy
        End If
    End If
    c = Mid(maze, py * COLS + px + 1, 1)
    If c = "." Then
        SetCell px, py
        score = score + 10
        pellets = pellets - 1
    ElseIf c = "o" Then
        SetCell px, py
        score = score + 50
        pellets = pellets - 1
        fright = 50 - 5 * level
        If fright < 16 Then fright = 16
        SetScared 1
    End If
    If score > hi Then hi = score
End Sub

' Move bug i by one cell. It never turns back (unless it is in a dead end) and picks the free direction that
' brings it closest to its target: bug 0 targets you, bug 1 the cells ahead of you, bug 2 a random spot.
' A scared bug just wanders.
Sub MoveBug(i As Integer)
    Dim x, y, dx, dy, rdx, rdy
    Dim d, ddx, ddy, nx, ny, tx, ty
    Dim sc, bd, bdx, bdy
    Dim found As Boolean
    x = GetG(i, 0)
    y = GetG(i, 1)
    dx = GetG(i, 2)
    dy = GetG(i, 3)
    rdx = 0 - dx
    rdy = 0 - dy
    If i = 0 Then
        tx = px
        ty = py
    ElseIf i = 1 Then
        tx = px + 3 * pdx
        ty = py + 3 * pdy
    Else
        tx = Int(Rnd * COLS)
        ty = Int(Rnd * ROWS)
    End If
    bd = 999999
    bdx = 0
    bdy = 0
    found = False
    For d = 0 To 3
        ddx = DirX(d)
        ddy = DirY(d)
        If Not IsWall(x + ddx, y + ddy) Then
            If Not (ddx = rdx And ddy = rdy) Then
                nx = WrapX(x + ddx)
                ny = y + ddy
                If GetG(i, 4) = 1 And fright > 0 Then
                    sc = Rnd * 1000
                Else
                    sc = (nx - tx) * (nx - tx) + (ny - ty) * (ny - ty)
                End If
                If sc < bd Then
                    bd = sc
                    bdx = ddx
                    bdy = ddy
                    found = True
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next d
    If Not found Then
        bdx = rdx
        bdy = rdy
    End If
    SetG i, 0, WrapX(x + bdx)
    SetG i, 1, y + bdy
    SetG i, 2, bdx
    SetG i, 3, bdy
End Sub

' Did a bug reach the player? A scared bug is eaten, otherwise the player loses a life.
Sub CheckHits()
    Dim i
    For i = 0 To 2
        If GetG(i, 0) = px And GetG(i, 1) = py Then
            If GetG(i, 4) = 1 And fright > 0 Then
                score = score + 200
                SetG i, 0, 9
                SetG i, 1, 8
                SetG i, 2, 0
                SetG i, 3, 0
                SetG i, 4, 0
            Else
                LoseLife
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub LoseLife()
    lives = lives - 1
    If lives <= 0 Then
        GameOver
    Else
        ResetPositions
        hold = 12
    End If
End Sub

Sub GameOver()
    playing = False
    over = True
    StopTimer
End Sub

Sub NextLevel()
    level = level + 1
    InitMaze
    ResetPositions
    hold = 15
    StartTimer Speed()
End Sub

' Timer interval in ms: a bit faster on every level.
Function Speed() As Integer
    Dim s As Integer
    s = 150 - 10 * (level - 1)
    If s < 80 Then s = 80
    Return s
End Function

' ---------- setup ----------
Sub InitMaze()
    Dim i
    maze = ""
    maze = maze & "###################"
    maze = maze & "#o.......#.......o#"
    maze = maze & "#.##.###.#.###.##.#"
    maze = maze & "#.................#"
    maze = maze & "#.##.#.#####.#.##.#"
    maze = maze & "#....#...#...#....#"
    maze = maze & "####.### # ###.####"
    maze = maze & "####.#       #.####"
    maze = maze & "......       ......"
    maze = maze & "####.#       #.####"
    maze = maze & "####.# ##### #.####"
    maze = maze & "#........#........#"
    maze = maze & "#.##.###.#.###.##.#"
    maze = maze & "#o.#...........#.o#"
    maze = maze & "##.#.#.#####.#.#.##"
    maze = maze & "#....#...#...#....#"
    maze = maze & "#.######.#.######.#"
    maze = maze & "#.................#"
    maze = maze & "###################"
    pellets = 0
    For i = 1 To Len(maze)
        If Mid(maze, i, 1) = "." Or Mid(maze, i, 1) = "o" Then pellets = pellets + 1
    Next i
End Sub

Sub ResetPositions()
    Dim i
    px = 9
    py = 13
    pdx = 0
    pdy = 0
    ndx = 0
    ndy = 0
    fx = -1
    fy = 0
    fright = 0
    tickN = 0
    gs = Replace(Space(30), " ", "0")
    For i = 0 To 2
        SetG i, 0, 8 + i
        SetG i, 1, 8
        SetG i, 2, 0
        SetG i, 3, 0
        SetG i, 4, 0
    Next i
End Sub

' ---------- helpers ----------
Function GetG(i As Integer, f As Integer) As Integer
    Return Val(Mid(gs, i * 10 + f * 2 + 1, 2)) - OFS
End Function

Sub SetG(i As Integer, f As Integer, v As Integer)
    Dim p
    p = i * 10 + f * 2
    gs = Left(gs, p) & (v + OFS) & Mid(gs, p + 3)
End Sub

Sub SetScared(v As Integer)
    Dim i
    For i = 0 To 2
        SetG i, 4, v
    Next i
End Sub

Sub SetCell(x As Integer, y As Integer)
    Dim i
    i = y * COLS + x
    maze = Left(maze, i) & " " & Mid(maze, i + 2)
End Sub

' Columns wrap around (the tunnel); rows do not.
Function WrapX(x As Integer) As Integer
    If x < 0 Then Return x + COLS
    If x >= COLS Then Return x - COLS
    Return x
End Function

Function IsWall(x As Integer, y As Integer) As Boolean
    If y < 0 Then Return True
    If y >= ROWS Then Return True
    If Mid(maze, y * COLS + WrapX(x) + 1, 1) = "#" Then Return True
    Return False
End Function

' Directions 0 = up, 1 = right, 2 = down, 3 = left.
Function DirX(d As Integer) As Integer
    If d = 1 Then Return 1
    If d = 3 Then Return -1
    Return 0
End Function

Function DirY(d As Integer) As Integer
    If d = 0 Then Return -1
    If d = 2 Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

' ---------- drawing: the whole picture is repainted in one go, so nothing flickers ----------
Sub Draw()
    Dim x, y, ch, i
    Canvas1.Clear
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#0d1017"
    Canvas1.FillRect 0, 0, COLS * CELL, ROWS * CELL
    For y = 0 To ROWS - 1
        For x = 0 To COLS - 1
            ch = Mid(maze, y * COLS + x + 1, 1)
            If ch = "#" Then
                Canvas1.DrawColor = "#2f55e0"
                Canvas1.FillRect x * CELL + 4, y * CELL + 4, 12, 12
                If x < COLS - 1 Then
                    If IsWall(x + 1, y) Then Canvas1.FillRect x * CELL + 16, y * CELL + 4, 8, 12
                End If
                If y < ROWS - 1 Then
                    If IsWall(x, y + 1) Then Canvas1.FillRect x * CELL + 4, y * CELL + 16, 12, 8
                End If
            ElseIf ch = "." Then
                Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffe6a8"
                Canvas1.FillCircle x * CELL + 10, y * CELL + 10, 2
            ElseIf ch = "o" Then
                Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffd166"
                If (tickN Mod 2) = 0 Then
                    Canvas1.FillCircle x * CELL + 10, y * CELL + 10, 6
                Else
                    Canvas1.FillCircle x * CELL + 10, y * CELL + 10, 4
                End If
            End If
        Next x
    Next y
    For i = 0 To 2
        DrawBug i
    Next i
    DrawPlayer
    If over Then
        Banner "GAME OVER - press Enter"
    ElseIf paused Then
        Banner "PAUSED"
    ElseIf Not playing Then
        Banner "Press Enter to start"
    ElseIf hold > 0 Then
        Banner "READY!"
    End If
    lblScore.Caption = "Score: " & score & "   Best: " & hi
    lblLives.Caption = "Lives: " & lives & "   Level: " & level
End Sub

' The player: a round mint-green blob with two eyes and a mouth that opens and closes.
Sub DrawPlayer()
    Dim cx, cy
    cx = px * CELL + 10
    cy = py * CELL + 10
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#2ee6a6"
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx, cy, 8
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffffff"
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx + fx - 4 * fy, cy + fy + 4 * fx, 3
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx + fx + 4 * fy, cy + fy - 4 * fx, 3
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#10202a"
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx + 2 * fx - 4 * fy, cy + 2 * fy + 4 * fx, 1.5
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx + 2 * fx + 4 * fy, cy + 2 * fy - 4 * fx, 1.5
    If (tickN Mod 2) = 0 Then
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#0d1017"
        If fx <> 0 Then
            Canvas1.FillRect cx + fx * 6 - 3, cy - 2, 6, 4
        Else
            Canvas1.FillRect cx - 2, cy + fy * 6 - 3, 4, 6
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' A bug: a round body with legs and feelers. Scared bugs turn blue and flash before they recover.
Sub DrawBug(i As Integer)
    Dim cx, cy, col, bdx, bdy
    Dim scared As Boolean
    cx = GetG(i, 0) * CELL + 10
    cy = GetG(i, 1) * CELL + 10
    bdx = GetG(i, 2)
    bdy = GetG(i, 3)
    scared = False
    If GetG(i, 4) = 1 Then
        If fright > 0 Then scared = True
    End If
    If i = 0 Then
        col = "#ff5c8a"
    ElseIf i = 1 Then
        col = "#ffb347"
    Else
        col = "#5cd6ff"
    End If
    If scared Then
        col = "#6f7cff"
        If fright < 14 And (fright Mod 2) = 0 Then col = "#f2f2f2"
    End If
    Canvas1.DrawColor = col
    Canvas1.FillCircle cx, cy, 8
    Canvas1.LineWidth = 2
    Canvas1.DrawLine cx - 5, cy + 6, cx - 7, cy + 10
    Canvas1.DrawLine cx + 5, cy + 6, cx + 7, cy + 10
    Canvas1.DrawLine cx - 3, cy - 6, cx - 6, cy - 10
    Canvas1.DrawLine cx + 3, cy - 6, cx + 6, cy - 10
    Canvas1.LineWidth = 1
    If scared Then
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#101428"
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx - 3, cy - 1, 1.5
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx + 3, cy - 1, 1.5
        Canvas1.DrawLine cx - 4, cy + 4, cx + 4, cy + 4
    Else
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffffff"
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx - 3, cy - 1, 3
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx + 3, cy - 1, 3
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#101428"
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx - 3 + bdx, cy - 1 + bdy, 1.5
        Canvas1.FillCircle cx + 3 + bdx, cy - 1 + bdy, 1.5
    End If
End Sub

Sub Banner(msg As String)
    Dim w, bx
    w = Len(msg) * 8 + 24
    bx = Int((COLS * CELL - w) / 2)
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#000000"
    Canvas1.FillRect bx, 170, w, 40
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffffff"
    Canvas1.DrawRect bx, 170, w, 40
    Canvas1.DrawText msg, bx + 12, 183
End Sub

Arrows  steer
Space  pause
Enter  new game

Eat all dots. Big dots
make the bugs scared.
